Order 
The petitioners seek a direction to the learned Special Court for Exclusive Trail of Cases under SC/ST(POA) Act Sessions Judge, Dindigul District to consider their bail application on the same day of their surrender in Crime No.17 of 2025 on the file of the second respondent Police.

entities.text: SC/ST(POA) Act Sessions Judge, Dindigul District
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
2. In view of the specific bar under Section 18 of the Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989 and also taking into consideration of the facts of the case, there shall be a direction to the learned Special Court for Exclusive Trail of Cases under SC/ST(POA) Act Sessions Judge, Dindigul District to consider the petitioners' bail application on the same day of their surrender in connection with Crime No.17 of 2025 registered for the offences under Section 376(1) of IPC and Sections 3(1)(r), 3(1)(w)(i) and 3(1)(w)(ii) of SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act,
1989 and pass appropriate orders in accordance with law.
